messages:
deploy-bot: finished canary rollout for release v0.43.0 -> starting postdeploy smoke window (10m) for route=generate, embed
nina: starting quickchecks. running synth-set=gen-short, healthcheck=service-ping, kvprobe=prefix-liveness
lee: observed 5% increase in generate p50 in canary-usw2 ~ +30ms (baseline 55ms -> 85ms)
chris: any 5xxs?
triage-bot: alert: 2 failed synth probes (s-9912, s-9918) returned status 502 on host gen-canary-3
lee: logs show backend error: "context canceled" around request de-queue
nina: could be transient, starting a focused replay on gen-canary-3 for 15m
pat: recommend sampling more gen-short probes and correlate with cpu steal/host GC events
chris: i've seen similar when a host had a noisy cron job. can we check cron triggers?
triage-bot: infra-event: scheduled-maintenance-job started on gen-canary-3 at t-639100, duration 120s
lee: that matches the timing for the 502s. marking as maintenance-induced spike.
nina: ok, will exclude gen-canary-3 from current canary pool and re-run synths
triage-bot: excluding instance gen-canary-3 from canary routing
pat: re-run results: gen p50 back to 58ms, synth failures resolved.
chris: we should note in release notes: "canary transient spike due to scheduled maintenance on gen-canary-3; excluded instance and resumed"
nina: adding follow-up to track scheduled cron jobs alignment with canary windows.
pat: propose to add a check in quickcheck to surface host maintenance windows in future canary runs
lee: +1 that would have caught this earlier
triage-bot: monitoring resumed for remaining 45m of postdeploy window
pat: keeping global rollout paused for 20m to ensure no further anomalies
nina: if clean at end of window, proceed with gradual rollout. documenting thread in release log
chris: thanks folks. small but good catch. end of thread."
